sentences.text:
Learned APP waives service of rule for the respondent-State.
2.

The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with FIR being C.R.NO. 11214020230964 of 2023 registered with Kamrej Police Station, Surat.
3. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that considering the nature of the offence, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.

4. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail, inter alia, contending that the applicant impersonated herself as Kashiben Bhagwandas Patel and claimed the amount of compensation for acquisition of land NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/1596/2024 Kashiben Bhagwanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40225804/
1 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2024 undefined belonging to somebody else.

entities.text: Kashiben Bhagwanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus, there is an active participation on the part of present applicant in commission of offence in question.

She, therefore,
submitted to dismiss the present application.
5. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers.
In present case, the investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.

In present case,
the present applicant is alleged to have impersonated herself as Kashiben Bhagwandas Patel and having claimed the amount of compensation of Rs.95 lacs from the Land Acquisition Authorities,
which was to be paid to actual Kashiben Bhagwandas Patel.

From the record, it appears that the present applicant was produced before the concerned authorities by the other co-accused as Kashiben Bhagwandas Patel and the amount of compensation was claimed by them.
The other co- accused have been considered for grant of regular bail by the concerned Sessions Court.

Moreover,
the applicant is aged about 64 years.

6. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40.
7.

entities.text: Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/1596/2024 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2024 undefined 8.
Hence, the present application is allowed.

entities.text: Kashiben Bhagwanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. The authorities will release the applicant only if she is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.

If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/1596/2024 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2024 undefined appropriate action in the matter.
10. Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
11. At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
12. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(M. R. MENGDEY,J) GIRISH Kashiben Bhagwanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40225804/
